en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a wide view of exhibition buildings along a broad, unpaved avenue lined with small trees. On the left is a lower, gabled structure with decorative scrollwork on its façades, while to the right stands a larger, ornate exhibition hall with tall arched windows, domes, and detailed architectural ornamentation. Leafless trees and landscaped beds are visible in the foreground. Red printed text in Hungarian appears at the top of the card.
